scripts.check: bun run check:tools && bun run format:check && bun run check:boundary && bun run check:integrity && bun run check:generation && bun run check:publication && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:portable && bun run build:portable
scripts.check:tools: set -eu; for tool in bun go gofmt node; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { printf 'Required portable check tool is missing: %s\n' "$tool" >&2; exit 127; }; done; test -x node_modules/.bin/prettier || { printf 'Run bun install --frozen-lockfile before check; pinned Prettier is missing.\n' >&2; exit 127; }
scripts.format:check: set -eu; unformatted="$(gofmt -l .)"; if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then printf 'The following files need gofmt:\n%s\n' "$unformatted"; exit 1; fi; node_modules/.bin/prettier --check $(git ls-files -- '*.js' '*.mjs')
scripts.build:portable: set -eu; build_dir="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$build_dir"' EXIT; go build -o "$build_dir/" ./...
